name: Airbnb
tagline: Book unique homes and experiences all over the world
description: Airbnb is an online marketplace for lodging, primarily homestays for vacation rentals, and tourism activities. The platform allows hosts to list their properties for short-term rental and enables guests to search and book unique accommodations worldwide. Founded in 2008, Airbnb disrupted the traditional hospitality industry by creating a peer-to-peer marketplace that connects travelers with local hosts.
